channel.title: Jiǎoluò Shūwū · 角落書屋
channel.description: A reading nook for Chinese language and civilisation. Characters, vocabulary, grammar, history, philosophy, and the world they shaped.

item.title: 笔 · pen, brush, a stroke, writing
item.description: Bamboo over hair: the bamboo-handled writing brush drawn as a character. From the implement grow the act of writing, the strokes that build a glyph, and a measure word for sums and deals.

item.title: 表 · surface, to express, a table, a watch
item.description: The garment radical worn on the outside: 表 runs from the outer surface of things to showing feeling, the chart on a page, and the watch on a wrist.

item.title: 才 · talent, ability, only-then, not until
item.description: A sprout breaking ground, the first sign of growth. From that image grow two threads: talent as raw promise, and the adverb 才 that marks something later, harder, or smaller than expected.

item.title: 当 · to be, just at, ought; (dàng) appropriate, to treat as
item.description: A high-frequency polyphone with two readings. As dāng it means to serve as, to be at a given time or place, and ought to; as dàng it means appropriate, to treat something as, and to pawn. The tone tells you which sense is in play.

item.title: 定 · to fix, settle, decide, surely
item.description: A settling element coming to rest under a roof. From that image of a thing made still and fixed in place grows the whole field of 定: to decide, to set, the fixed and stable, the certain and sure.

item.title: 而 · and, but, yet (a classical connective)
item.description: A pictograph of a beard, borrowed early as one of the busiest function words in literary Chinese. 而 links clause to clause as and, but, or yet, ties manner to verb, and frames set phrases like 而且 and 而已.

item.title: 发 · to send out, to develop, hair
item.description: One simplified glyph that swallowed two traditional characters. 发 carries the fa reading of sending, emitting, and developing (traditional 發) and the fa reading of hair on the head (traditional 髮).

item.title: 公 · public, fair, common, a duke, male
item.description: A line dividing away the private self. From that image grow everything held in common, every fair dealing, the metric measures, and the elder male: public, impartial, official, and a duke.

item.title: 故 · reason; old; deliberately; therefore
item.description: 故 binds five senses into one glyph: cause, the old and former, deliberateness, the literary "hence," and the deceased. The thread is a settled cause behind what is done or what has passed.

item.title: 合 · to join, combine, suit, close
item.description: A lid closing down over the mouth of a vessel. From that image of two parts meeting and fitting grows the whole field of joining, suiting, closing, and adding up into a whole.

item.title: 画 · to draw, a painting, a stroke
item.description: A hand with a brush drawing the boundaries of a field. From that image grows the whole world of pictures: to paint, a painting, and the single stroke of a character.

item.title: 件 · item, piece, measure word
item.description: The measure word for matters, garments, and gifts, and the character behind documents, parts, and cases.

item.title: 节 · joint, node, festival, to economize
item.description: A bamboo joint, the segment between the knots. From that node grows everything that comes in sections: the joint of a limb, the chapter of a book, the festival that knots the calendar, and the restraint that keeps a thing within bounds.

item.title: 句 · sentence, phrase, a unit of speech
item.description: A wrapping line drawn over a mouth: speech bundled into a single unit. From that image grows the sentence, the line of verse, and the measure word that counts the remarks we say.

item.title: 乐 · happy, joyful (lè); music (yuè)
item.description: A picture of a wooden frame strung with silk and a drum, an early musical instrument. The simplified 乐 carries two readings: yuè for music, the original sense, and lè for joy, the happiness that music gives.

item.title: 力 · strength, power, force, effort
item.description: A picture of a plough or a flexed sinew, the image of bodily exertion. From that one shape grows everything pushed by force: raw strength, the capacity to do, and the effort poured into a task.

item.title: 量 · quantity, capacity; to measure
item.description: 商量 shangliang, to discuss, is literally to measure something out together: the act of weighing it between two minds before anyone decides.

item.title: 论 · to discuss, a theory or treatise
item.description: Reasoned speech put in order: the verb for discussing, debating, and commenting, and the noun for a theory, a view, or a treatise. Also Lun in the title of the Analects.

item.title: 平 · flat, level, even, peaceful, ordinary
item.description: A pictograph of something level and balanced. From that flat surface grows a wide field of meaning: the even and the smooth, the equal and the fair, the calm and the peaceful, and the plain and ordinary.

item.title: 清 · clear, clean, pure, quiet
item.description: Water beside the color of new growth. The character that names limpid water, distinct speech, a clean reputation, a settled account, and a cool quiet evening.

item.title: 情 · feeling, affection, situation
item.description: The heart radical beside the phonetic 青: the movements of the heart. From that one image grows feeling and mood, affection and love, and the wider sense of a situation or state of affairs.

item.title: 如 · like, as, if, according to
item.description: A woman speaking and a mouth complying: from following a command grew the great comparison-and-condition word. 如 is how Chinese says like, as, for example, and if.

item.title: 声 · sound, voice, tone, reputation
item.description: A chime-stone struck before a listening ear. From that image grow the everyday word for sound and voice, the tone of speech, and the wider sense of making something known: a declaration, a reputation, a name.

item.title: 实 · real, solid, true, actual
item.description: A roof over a house full of goods. From that image of a full dwelling grows everything substantial: the real and the true, the solid and sturdy, the actual practice that gets things done, and the ripened fruit.

item.title: 题 · topic, question, problem, to inscribe
item.description: The head-radical character behind every exam question and discussion topic. From the leaf or head of a thing grows the question to solve, the theme to discuss, and the act of inscribing a poem.

item.title: 通 · to go through; to connect; general; fluent
item.description: The walk-movement radical drives a path through every obstacle, giving 通 a single character that covers passage, communication, expertise, and the ordinary general state of things.

item.title: 头 · head, top, end, chief, noun-suffix
item.description: The head, and from it the top of a hill, the end of a street, the start of a thing, the chief of a group, and the toneless tag on a hundred everyday nouns. The simplified 头 stands for traditional 頭.

item.title: 物 · thing, object, matter, being
item.description: An ox under a phonetic, once the word for varicolored cattle, that broadened into the whole world of things: every object, all matter, the myriad creatures, and even a person as a figure.

item.title: 向 · direction, toward, to face, all along
item.description: A window opening in a wall, facing one way. From that image grows the whole field of orientation: the direction a thing points, the preposition toward a target, the inclination of a heart, and the sense of all along, up to now.

item.title: 阳 · sun, bright, the yang principle
item.description: A sunlit mound: the simplified 阳 sets a hill beside the sun. From that bright south slope grow the sun itself, the active masculine half of the cosmos, and the place names that face the light.
